GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 000.5 (28 Dec 46) LS-R
(SCAPIN - 1425)
APO 500
28 December 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Apprehension of Suspected War Criminal.
Memorandum to the Imperial Japanese Government dated 17 January 1946, file AG 000.5 (17 Jan 46) LS-R, wherein the Imperial Japanese Government is directed to deliver one AAMORI, Masao, Capt., to the Commanding General, XI Corps, at Sugamo Prison (Tokyo Detention Camp), at the earliest possible date, is amended to delete said AAMORI's name. This name appears as the first name on Page No. 1 of the above mentioned Memorandum.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COOLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
